name: 98446 · Tacoma, WA
findings: ZIP 98446 (Tacoma) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98446 (Tacoma) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98446 (Tacoma) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).
